abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.text: Each time this unit makes an ingress move, if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent's deployment zone.
abilities.originalText: Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

abilities.name: Rampart (Once per battle, per army)
abilities.originalText: At the start of any phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has 2+ InSv until the end of the phase.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.
